name: What should I prepare before contractors arrive to install garage flooring?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contractors arrive to install garage flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation begins, the entire garage floor must be emptied completely, including vehicles, tools, storage bins, and freestanding shelving. Take time to inspect the bottom edges of drywall and baseboards, as any moisture damage or framing repairs should be addressed before the floor coating is laid. Check whether outdoor drainage slopes toward your garage door, as exterior water pooling can affect edge bonding. If your remodel also involves carpentry, interior painting, or electrical updates, coordinate to finish messy ceiling and wall work before applying the final clear floor topcoat so dust does not ruin the finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty the garage completely, check for drywall or water issues at the slab edges, and plan heavy wall or ceiling repairs before the floor is sealed.
